catalyst_rows.raw_text: The Zydus Transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, including the tender of a majority of the Company's outstanding shares.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier1 captures the Zydus tender-offer acquisition close Q2 2026 ($23.50/share). ASRT is a commercial-stage pharma (Rolvedon); recent 8-Ks dominated by M&A process (Garda then superseded by Zydus) rather than clinical catalysts.
